annotations.title: Build staking v2: stake / withdraw / claim / exit (gas-padded)

description: One call for staking v2 (NOT DEPLOYED YET): ordered txs[] for stake (exact approve + stake), withdraw, claimAll, claimMany (defaults to only tokens with rewards), exit or emergencyWithdraw, each with a summary, a simulation, warnings, and a gas limit. withdraw / exit / emergencyWithdraw / claimAll carry gas = max(estimateGas x 1.25, 1.1M) because a cold exit can use ~885k. Returns UNSIGNED txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

action.description: stake: deposit. withdraw: take back some (the rest must stay >= minStake or be 0). claimAll: every reward token (all-or-nothing). claimMany: chosen tokens (default: tokens with rewards). exit: withdraw all + claim all. emergencyWithdraw: last resort, principal only, rewards stay claimable.

amount.description: Staking-token amount in HUMAN units, e.g. "250" = 250 BZB. Required for stake and withdraw.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

tokens.description: claimMany only: reward token addresses. Default: every token where earned > 0.

name: blazar_build_staking_v2

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.
